Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /admin/telemedicine-reports 2. Await profile & table sync
Expected Result: Header Reports, Upload Report button, and directory table render cleanly.

Test Steps: 1. Inspect table header row
Expected Result: Table contains columns: Report ID, Patient ID, Patient, Doctor, Status, and Date.

Test Steps: 1. Inspect table footer pagination area
Expected Result: Pagination renders Previous, page status formatted as <currentPage>/<totalPages> (e.g. 1/1), and Next button.

Test Steps: 1. View empty report review table
Expected Result: Table displays empty state or 0 rows gracefully without console errors or broken borders.

Test Steps: 1. Set viewport to 375x667 / 768x1024 2. Inspect table and controls
Expected Result: Upload button and directory table adapt cleanly with horizontal scrollability.

Test Steps: 1. Click Upload Report button
Expected Result: Modal dialog opens with title Enter patient unique identifier, query input, and Search button.

Test Scenario: Dismiss Patient Search Dialog via Close Button
Test Steps: 1. Click Close button
Expected Result: Modal dialog dismisses immediately; focus returns to main directory view.

Test Steps: 1. Enter non-NIC/non-phone query (e.g. invalid_123) 2. Click Search
Expected Result: Dialog displays red error: Please enter a valid Sri Lankan NIC, or Mobile Number.

Test Steps: 1. Leave search query field blank 2. Click Search
Expected Result: Search is blocked; input indicates required field or displays format warning.

Test Scenario: Special Characters & Script Injection in Query
Test Steps: 1. Enter query <script>alert('xss')</script> 2. Click Search
Expected Result: Input is sanitized; validation error displays without executing script.

Test Steps: 1. Enter valid 10-digit mobile number 2. Click Search
Expected Result: Dispatches GET /patients/getUniqueIdentifyPatients; returns matched patient cards with Add button.

Test Scenario: Search Patient by 9-Digit Old NIC Format
Test Steps: 1. Enter 9-digit NIC with trailing letter V or X 2. Click Search
Expected Result: System queries global patient database and renders matching patient card.

Test Scenario: Search Patient by 12-Digit New NIC Format
Test Steps: 1. Enter 12-digit national identity number 2. Click Search
Expected Result: System queries global patient database and renders matching patient card.

Test Steps: 1. Enter valid format number not in system (e.g. 0700000000) 2. Click Search
Expected Result: Displays 0 patient cards; renders Not the right patient? Create New Patient option.

Test Scenario: Fallback Link to Register New Patient
Test Steps: 1. Click Create New Patient button
Expected Result: Navigates to /admin/telemedicine-reports/patients/new?query=0771234567 with query pre-filled.

Test Scenario: Add Patient to Local Practice and Open Review
Test Steps: 1. Click Add button on matched patient card
Expected Result: Dispatches POST /patients/addPatientsForLocal; navigates to /admin/telemedicine-reports/patients/[id].

Test Steps: 1. Inspect header, status, and action buttons
Expected Result: Displays Patient Name, Report ID badge (e.g. RR-ejEgB), Status DRAFT, Add Report, and Send to Patient.

Test Steps: 1. Inspect doctor assignment selector
Expected Result: Selector loads practice doctors list via GET /telemed/admin/all-doctors; allows re-assignment.

Test Steps: 1. Inspect Reviews list in sidebar
Expected Result: Lists prior review sessions with timestamps, Report IDs, and status badges (DRAFT/COMPLETED).

Test Steps: 1. Click Add Report button
Expected Result: Modal opens displaying title Add Report, file constraints note, Select files, and Confirm Uploads.

Test Scenario: Dismiss File Upload Modal via Close Button
Test Steps: 1. Click Close button
Expected Result: File upload modal dismisses cleanly without uploading.

Test Steps: 1. Select valid PDF file (e.g. CBC_Report.pdf) 2. Click Confirm Uploads
Expected Result: Dispatches multipart upload; file attaches to review session; listed under report items.

Test Steps: 1. Select image file (e.g. XRay_Chest.jpg) 2. Click Confirm Uploads
Expected Result: Image uploads successfully and preview thumbnail appears in review workspace.

Test Steps: 1. Attempt to select executable or archive file

Expected Result: Dispatches notification API; status transitions from DRAFT to COMPLETED/SENT; notification sent.

Expected Result: System prevents dispatch or displays warning: Please attach at least one diagnostic report.

Expected Result: Navigates back to /admin/telemedicine-reports; directory table and Upload button reload.
